checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1, the same page as the itemized prices, which counts as placed correctly.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only one basic services and overhead fee; no other mandatory facilities, handling, or staff fee appears.
The embalming disclosure is on page 1, the same page as the $795 embalming price, which counts as placed correctly.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
The alternative-container disclosure is on page 2, the same page as the direct cremation range, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation is offered with options including container provided by purchaser; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation entries contain no statement about the crematory fee being included or billed separately as a cash advance.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered goods or services lack a price.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no required disclosure is shown printed in a hard-to-notice way.
